name: A 909-Concept Obstruction with a Four-Vertex-Path Reduction
definition: Take the 289-concept unique-corner block $B$ with path $H=2-0-4-5$, attach a disjoint-coordinate copy $(A,2)$ of the 289-concept rooted factor at the first endpoint, attach the certified 330-concept edge piece $P$ along $\{4,5\}$, put $U=B\cup A\cup P$ and $S=H\cup A\cup P$, and form $X=(B\times\{0\})\cup(S\times\{1\})$.
properties: $X$ is ample and not corner-peelable, while its contraction, both sections, and all $111$ elementary proper pc-minors are corner-peelable. Hence it is an ample pc-minimal obstruction. Its fresh-coordinate reduction is the path $2-0-4-5$, so that coordinate class has exactly four edges.
